objective: Small-web hardening cluster on the address flow and context panel, disjoint from the rule-evaluation display surface: DB-006 tighten address-search retryable classification to status>=500 (4xx never retried/labeled source_unavailable); DB-007 add the missing tests (full-address /search button offered on timeout; architect-mode Not-my-property focus return); DB-009 malformed-failure copy names the still-rendered full-address search button; DB-019a aria-hidden on the two ZoLa link glyphs; DB-019b PropertyOverview renders the honest absent note on null BBL (matching panel + confirm card); DB-019c surface mapped-feature coverage_status on the panel landmark/historic rows
business_reason: Address search is the product front door (external review item 7); these are the recorded small defects and polish items blocking a calm, honest flow
inputs: CHECKPOINT ENVELOPE (binding; two S4.5 stops proved this): in every checkpoint, OMIT the four envelope fields (branch, worktree, starting_sha, current_sha) entirely - the controller fills the authoritative values itself. If you do supply one, it must match EXACTLY full-length: 40-hex SHAs from `git rev-parse HEAD` (never --short), the FULL worktree path. Any abbreviated value stops the run.

Run `python tools/code_graph/query.py --no-regen impact <path>` BEFORE broad sweeps. Graph is ADVISORY - verify every material conclusion in source. SCOPE (six bounded items, all recorded discoveries): DB-006 - address-search retry/label gate: only status >= 500 (and network failure) classifies as retryable source_unavailable; 4xx becomes a distinct non-retried outcome with honest copy. DB-007 - two missing tests: (a) the timeout outcome offers the full-address /search button (assert the affordance renders), (b) architect-mode 'Not my property' returns focus per the existing nonce/useEffect pattern (CODING_RULES: never .focus() synchronously in a handler whose state change remounts the target). DB-009 - the malformed-failure copy names the still-rendered full-address search button (copy/affordance match). DB-019a - the two ZoLa link glyphs get aria-hidden (matches the pre-existing sibling pattern). DB-019b - PropertyOverview renders the honest absent note on null BBL, copy-consistent with ZoningContextPanel and AddressConfirmCard. DB-019c - panel landmark/historic rows surface the mapped-feature coverage_status (display only - no computation, no new data source).

HONESTY RULES (binding): label display only; no new computation; DB-008's 6000 ms deadline is a deliberate owner decision - do NOT change the deadline value; preserve the user's typed input through every failure path. D-064 lean comms in the report.

Discovery routing (D-069): surface out-of-scope findings in your report; never fix them in-packet. No npm/npx/node locally (vitest/Playwright prove ONLY in CI on the pushed head - write the tests, CI runs them). Do not propose WebFetch. Every checkpoint carries IMPLEMENTATION. Typed DOM queries per CODING_RULES (querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>); deliberate invalid-shape probes as `as unknown as T`.
